What is a /.well-known/ucp profile for AI shopping agents?

A /.well-known/ucp profile is a JSON file a store publishes at /.well-known/ucp, the machine-readable profile AI shopping agents read. In the ShopBot Index crawl of 9 November 2026, 951 of the 2,225 retailers and stores we could check publish a UCP profile (42.7%): 841 of the 1,042 Shopify stores we could check, and 16 of the 255 big retailers we could check, and publishing one does not by itself prove that agents can check out.

Does a UCP profile mean AI agents can check out at a store?

No. A UCP profile is a published declaration. It does not by itself prove that AI agents can check out at a store. In the crawl of 9 November 2026, 947 of the 951 stores that publish a UCP profile declare checkout (dev.ucp.shopping.checkout). That declaration is not a completed checkout, and ShopBot Index does not test purchases.

To check a store, fetch https://your-domain/.well-known/ucp or look the domain up on Check your store and the all-stores table. The lookup reads the crawl of 9 November 2026 and does not fetch the store live. Which stores declare UCP checkout names the stores whose profile declares checkout. The longer reading is What a published UCP profile proves, and what it doesn't.
